page_title: MON 4-1 WER | B. Monchengladbach v Werder Bremen 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' A dangerous towering header by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90+5' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.

90+4' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the top right corner, but Michael Zetterer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen). The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen win a corner kick.
90+1' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

57' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out for a corner. Werder Bremen can continue in their attacking effort.
55' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.

52' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

48' Werder Bremen fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.

20' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

20' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Michael Zetterer stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.

14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
14' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
